content: Yesus tuku kuasmbi Antiokŋge minnaig ta afu tuan taŋgo afu tum taŋgo taŋaŋ pirokinaig. Ande nyunu Barnabas ande Simeon nyun ta Dabuk Dabuk ŋginaig. Ande Sirenenu taŋgo nyunu Lusius. Ande Manaen nu buk Herodus ndoŋ kiŋo foŋfoŋ wande ndindo mbolŋge minnaik tuku. Ande Saulus.
Mara ande nane ŋakmba maŋgurka nyamagaŋ pinka Suŋgo tuku nyu te-duŋga minnaig le Tukul Guwa nu nane saniŋgina: Barnabas le Saulus ye buk piro ande tuku madiniken ta kile nale kam tuku patikap ŋgina.
Taŋakina le nane nyamagaŋ pinka Kuate yabaŋmba nane naŋgine wai Barnabas le Saulus mbolŋge patika kile pirokuwaik ŋga kukulnikinaig le kinaik.
Siprus mbal pasa mayenu isnaig
Tukul Guwa nu nale kukulnikina le nale Antiok kusremba ndek Selusia kinaik. Nale Yohanus Markus nale turkuwa ŋga tumba ŋak kinaik. Kinaig ka Selusiaŋge waŋ poŋga ka Siprus nuy mbol kinaig ka
Salamisŋge ibeŋ kinaig. Salamis tumbraŋ suŋgo mbolŋge nane piro tugu pilmba kusem wande mbolŋge Kuate tuku pasa kuklinaig.
Nane nuy ta tuku ma ŋakmba mbol lika pasa kuklimba ka Pafos pronaig. Pro taŋge nane Zu taŋgo ande yabri tuan taŋgo nyunu Bar-Yesus te-silikinaig. Taŋgo ta nu kuanye taŋgo.
Pafosŋge taŋgo ande wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak nyunu Sersius Paulus nu gabat taŋgo minna. Nu Bar-Yesus ndoŋ gulab mayenu. Nu Kuate tuku pasa isam tuku Barnabas le Saulus wikina.
Nale pro pasa kuklimba sanaik le Bar-Yesus nu gabat taŋgo pasa ismba son ŋgikat ŋga nu nale tuku pasa ndin kuer-kuerna. (Bar-Yesus Grik pasambi nane Elimas
ŋginaig).
Taŋana le Saulus nyu ande Paulus Tukul Guwa nu mbol kumuŋgina le nu Elimas fumble timba sigair mbakmba sana:
Ne Satan tuku kiŋo. Ne maŋau tiŋreknu ŋakmba pitaikate. Ne yabri maŋau kumba wam ŋaigonu ndo ke likate. Ndaŋam saka ne Kuate tuku maŋau mayenu tumba yabri pasambi ndin tukulte.

Ata. Kile Kuateŋge ne tuku am tukulwa le ne ait afu agaŋ kaŋgerke nda ŋgina. Taŋakina le pitik ndo agaŋ inum bidu suk pro nu tuku am tukulna le am ma make ndekina. Taŋana le nu nane afu pro nu tuku wai biymba ndin tumwaig ŋga kumbaŋge nane wikina.
Taŋana le gabat suŋgo nu wam ta kaŋgermba pirerek purka Kuate tuku pasa isna ta Yesus tuku son ŋgina.
Kile Paulus nane waŋ poŋga Pafos kusremba ka Pamfilia ma mbol promba Pergaŋge ibeŋ kinaig. Pro taŋge Yohanus Markus nu nale kusreka luka Yerusalem kina.
Kina le Paulus le Barnabas nale Perga kusremba Pisidia ma Antiok tumbraŋ suŋgo mbol pronaik. Pro taŋge minmba kusem ait ande mbolŋge nale kumba ka Zu mbal tuku kusem wande sinam taŋge minyokinaik.

Minyokinaik le nane Moses tuan taŋgo kame tuku kuyar burke deŋpurmba kusem wande kulat mbal nane taŋgo ande kukulnaig le nu kumba Paulus nale sanikina: Tira kame, tale pasa afu taŋgo pino wamdus saŋgri pileniŋgam tuku ŋak ndeta saniŋgap ŋgina le
Paulus nu tiŋga wai te-duŋgina le nane maninkinaig le saniŋgina: Tane Israel mbal kasomok mbal Kuate kumnemŋge minig ta turmba tane ye tuku pasa isap.

Sine Israel mbal tuku Mbara nuŋge siŋgine mbuŋ kame madiniŋgina. Nu nane kulat magekina le nane Isip kilke mbolŋge rawe taŋgo minmba tugekinaig. Tugekinaig le Kuateŋge nuŋe saŋgrimbi ndin wakeina le nane Isip kusremba
yar 40 ma baknu mbolŋge minnaig le Kuate nu nane kusre ndakina.
Yar 40 kuganaig le Kuate nu Kanan ma mbolŋge mbal kise kise 7 kile-ibeŋka pitaikina sulumba kilke ta Israel mbal niŋgina. Niŋgina le nane yar 450 taŋamba taŋge minnaig.
Minnaig le Kuate nu nane kulatkam tuku taŋgo afu madiniŋmba patikina. Taŋamba kumba ka tuan taŋgo Samuel prona.

Samuel tuku ait mbolŋge siŋgine mbuŋ kame taŋgo ndindo naŋgine gabat suŋgo minam tuku Samuel kusnanaig. Kusnanaig le Kuate nu Benyamin tuku ndare Kis tuku kiŋo nuŋe Saul madimba pilna le nu yar 40 nane kulatkina.

Ŋgumneŋga Kuate nu Saul te-simba nane tuku gabat suŋgo minam tuku tugu kise David madimba pilmba sakina: Yesi tuku kiŋo nuŋe David nu ye ndoŋ wamdus ndindo ŋak. Nu ye tuku nzali ŋakmba dubikamŋgat ŋgina.
Kuate nu pasa saŋgrinu o buk sakina taŋamba nu David tuku mbuŋ ande Israel mbal tuku muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku kukulna ta Yesus.
Yesus nu piro tugu pile ndakina le amboŋga Yohanus nu Israel mbal nane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba kule pisne tuwaig ŋga saniŋmba minna.

Nu nuŋe piro suluwam patukina sulumba nu teŋenmba nane saniŋgina: Tane ye ima ŋga idusde? Ye Kristus kuga. Ande ye ŋgumnemŋge prowamŋgat ta nu suŋgo. Ye nu tuku kupe ŋgaro muli kukliwam tuku wam ŋai ta mata nu mbolŋge kam kumuŋ kuga ŋgina.
Yiŋe tira kame Abraham tuku mbuŋ kame kasomok mbal Kuate kumnemŋge minig tane ŋakmba isap. Sine muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku pasa mayenu ta o buk sine tugum prona.

Yerusalem mbal naŋgine gabat mbal ndoŋ Yesus nu Kuateŋge madina taŋgo Kristus ta nane gilai. Kusem mindek nane tuan taŋgo kame tuku kuyar burke likade ta nane wamdus pulu ndaniŋgina. Taŋamba nane Yesus kumwa ŋga sakinaig sulumba nane Kuate tuku kuyar pasa kumumba taŋanaig.
Nane nu balewam tuku mbar ande kaŋger ndanaig ta nane ake sinaŋ nu tumba Pilatusŋge balewa ŋga sanaig ta
nane kuyar pasa kumunaig. Nu kumna le nane nu ail kazrai mbolŋge paska mindesiŋ ndame burok sinamŋge pilnaig.
Pilnaig le Kuateŋge nu te-tina le maŋ tiŋgina.
Nu tiŋga nu dubinaig mbal buk Galilea kusremba Yerusalem pronaig ta nu nane tugumŋge mayok kanu le kaŋgeranu. Mbal ta kile Israel ŋgamukŋge nu tuku nyu te-mayokde.
Sile Barnabas ndoŋ tane mata pasa mayenu te isap ŋga te prowik. Kuate nu siŋgine mbuŋ kame pasa saŋgrinu saniŋgina ta
kile sine tugumŋge alonu te-mayokmba Yesus te-tina le tiŋgina. David nu nuŋe mune waŋe arnu mbolŋge ta tuku teŋenmba kuyarna le minit.

content.text: Ne ye tuku Kiŋo. Kite ye ne tuku Mam mayok kinet ŋgina. Mune 2.7

content: Kuateŋge Yesus te-tina le nduiye tiŋga ŋgarosu me ndaŋgina ta kuyar pasa ande mbolŋge Kuate nu wam ta te-mayokmba sakina:

content.text: Ye wam afu magenu ke likam tuku David sawen ta ye ne mbolŋge taŋamba kamŋgit ŋgina. Aisaia 55.3

content: David nu mune waŋe ande mbolŋge teŋenmba kuyarna.

content.text: Ye ne tuku piro taŋgo yiŋe ŋgarosu menu tuku ndin tukulamŋgat ŋgina. Mune 16.10

content: David nu Kuate tuku nzali dubimba nuŋe kuasmbi ŋgamukŋge pirokina sulumba kumna. Kumna le nane nu tumba nuŋe mbuŋ kame gemniŋmba ŋgukinaig le meŋgina.
Ande Kuateŋge te-tina le tiŋgina ta nu me ndaŋgina.
O tira kame, tane pasa te ise mayewap. Kuate nu Yesus te-tina ta nu mbolŋge nu sine tuku une sauka gilaiŋgate.
Tane taŋgine uneŋge didikate ta Moses tuku tukulŋge tane turkam kumuŋ kuga. Tane Yesus tuku kume tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgap le Kuateŋge tane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgamgat.
Tane riroŋ mayewap. Tuan taŋgo kame tuku pasa tane mbolŋge kumuŋgikat. Pasa ta teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Kuate talaka nzumil te-tuwig mbal tane isap.
Tane piriri ŋayomba ŋgisinuŋgaig. Tane tuku ait mbolŋge ye wam saŋgrinu ande ki ta tane son ŋge nda. Ande nu tugusemba wam ta kuklimba sakuwa ta mata tane son ŋge nda. Habakuk 1.5

content: Paulus nu taŋamba pasa kuklimba saniŋgina.
Kile Paulus le Barnabas mayok kinaik le nane maŋ kusem ande mbolŋge nale tuku pasa isam saka ŋgailkinaig.

Taŋamba nane sili-silimba kusem wande kusrenaig. Nane gudommba afu Zu mbal afu kasomok mbal Zu taŋaŋ Kuate dubinaig tuku ta nane Paulus le Barnabas dubika kinaig. Kumba ka taŋge nale nane ndoŋ pasa-pasakumba Kuate nu tane ake sinaŋ make patikina wam ta biye demba minap ŋga saniŋginaik.
Kusem ande mbolŋge Antiok mbal ŋakmba Kuate tuku pasa isam tuku maŋ pro maŋgurkinaig le

Zu mbal nane taŋgo pino gudommba pro maŋgurkinaig le kaŋgerka nane wamdus kagli firka gubra tinaig. Paulus nu pasa kuklimba minna le nane nu tumail panmba nu tuku pasa pitaimba nane pasa ndin kise sakinaig.

Nane taŋanaig ta Paulus le Barnabas nale kuru kuru ndaka saŋgri tiŋga saniŋginaig: Tane Zu mbal tane amboŋga Kuate tuku pasa mayenu isam tuku minig. Tane isam mbulmba pitaide ta abo minmba minam tuku ndin turmba pitaide. Ta tuku kile sile kasomok mbal tugum kaŋkik.
Kuate nu sile kasomok mbal pasa mayenu saniŋgam tuku teŋenmba sasikina.

content.text: Kilke mbol mbal muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku ye ne sati taŋaŋ kasomok mbal kilŋaniŋgam tuku ne pilet. Aisaia 42.6; 49.6

content: Paulus nale taŋamba saniŋginaig le
kasomok mbal pasa ta ismba nane gare suŋgo tumba Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋginaig. Nane abo minmba minam tuku Kuateŋge madiniŋgina ta nane pasa ta ismba son ŋginaig le
Kuate tuku pasa ma ta mbolŋge kumuŋga suŋgokina.

Suŋgokina le Zu mbal nane ndek gabat pino kame Kuate dubinaig tuku tumbraŋ suŋgo ta tuku gabat sugo turmba Paulus le Barnabas pitaikam tuku nane tuku wamdus kunde-kundenaig. Taŋanaig le gabat sugo nane gubra tumba sine tuku tumbraŋ te kusremba kape ŋga pitaikinaig le
Paulus nale kambim ŋga nane Kuate tuku pasa pitaide ta naŋgine mbar riroŋkuwaig ŋga tuptup kupe mbolŋge deŋganu ta nane am mbolŋge paurŋga nale Ikonium kinaik.
Yesus dubinaig mbal Antiokŋge minnaig ta Tukul Guwa nane tuku wamdus kumuŋgina le nane gare ŋak minnaig.
